HOW THIS FILE WORKS: keys are matched case-insensitively against the challenge NAME first, then slug, then numeric ID (see internal/challenges/challenges.go). This is the per-challenge strategy channel - expert knowledge that reaches the agent when no human is in the loop during a run. Replace this single example with your own entries, or set the whole file to {} to disable per-challenge hints entirely (the agent then falls back to pure category routing, which is where its real capability lives).
